toolsPreview.name: price_check
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a price for a collectible is FAIR / OVER / SCALPED vs the current retail median across the shops we poll. Returns the retail min/max/median, the number of shops carrying it, the price multiple, and a verdict. Use this to decide if a listing is overpriced before buying. niche must be one of: tcg (Pokémon & TCG), lego (LEGO sets), funko (Funko Pop), keebs (Mechanical keyboards), vinyl (Vinyl records), aqua (Aquarium livestock).
